svg.title: Chatham XIV: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Chatham XIV identified by EK465 caption in the 1979 Foundation view: left black/white work, distinct from right Chatham III black/blue. Overall aspect from MoMA2013 printed dimensions; internal panel ratios estimated from oblique historical photo. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-paintings-and-sculptures-1963-1979/; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
